note: A pristine two-page recipe with no overlay, no editorial pages and printed per-addition IBUs. The gold case for the hop split: the printed IBUs (25, 20 boil; 8, 7 whirlpool) sum to the stated 60, so the whirlpool fraction is exact arithmetic (15/60 = 0.25) rather than an estimate. Two '1 oz each Citra and Amarillo' dry hops decompose into four rows, each with its own warning. Why this fixture keeps being re-captured: under v6 the same page produced only six rows, with 'each Citra and Amarillo' left as a hop *name* - faithful to the line and unmappable in the ledger - because nothing in the prompt forbade it. v7 added the one-product-per-row rule, and the behaviour became reproducible instead of accidental. Reported-number counts move with the payload (31 at v5, 27 at v6, 28 at v7), which is why the tests assert the invariants (clean check, IBUs sum, 0.25) and not the total.
